title: Breadboard
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Breadboard
learningObjectives: Identify the parts of a solderless breadboard, including the power rails and the five-hole terminal strips on either side of the center channel
Explain which breadboard holes are electrically connected to one another and why components must span the center channel
Trace the current path of an LED circuit from the positive rail through a momentary push button and a current-limiting resistor back to ground
Predict whether the LED lights when the push button is pressed or released, based on whether the button closes the circuit
Explain why a resistor is placed in series with the LED and how its value limits current
